hook: Your eyes would swear this lake is edited.
title: This Bubblegum Pink Lake Is Real
description:
Lake Hillier in Western Australia looks bubblegum pink from above. Salt-loving microbes in the water are the likely cause. A narrow strip of land separates it from the blue ocean.

#Shorts #geography #LakeHillier
